scan_table_check.description:
Flags update sets that capture any change, including a delete, to a protected component: - a record listed in the ECS Protected Component table (u_ecs_protected_component), matched by sys_id, so any record type works and renames do not matter. A change made by a member of the component's owner group is not reported; with no owner group, every change is reported. The finding names the owner group, the reason and who made the change. - a change to the protected-component list itself (rows of u_ecs_protected_component are captured in update sets). - during the transition: Business Rules and Script Includes named in the system properties instance_scan.peer_review.critical.business_rules / .script_includes, and changes to those properties.
Replaces the legacy checks "NS: Critical Business Rule Changed" and "NS: Critical Script Include Changed".
scan_table_check.name: SN-CFG-008: Change to a protected component
scan_table_check.resolution_details: Confirm the change was approved by the component's owner group before the update set is promoted, or have a member of that group make the change. Manage the list in the ECS Protected Component table (role u_ecs_protected_component_user).
scan_table_check.short_description: The update set changes or deletes a protected component, or the list itself.
scan_table_check.sys_name: SN-CFG-008: Change to a protected component
